{"exit_code": 0, "timed_out": false, "elapsed_seconds": 0.235000000015134, "stdout": "import ProbabilityTheory.chapter_09.def_9_3
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Log

open MeasureTheory Set

/-- The real numbers represented by integers. -/
def integerPoints : Set ℝ := Set.range fun n : ℤ => (n : ℝ)

lemma measurableSet_integerPoints : MeasurableSet integerPoints := by
  exact Set.countable_range (fun n : ℤ => (n : ℝ)) |>.measurableSet

lemma cos_two_pi_eq_one_iff_integer (x : ℝ) :
    Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x) = 1 ↔ x ∈ integerPoints := by
  rw [Real.cos_eq_one_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have hp : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hp)
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hn
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    ring

lemma exp_two_pi_I_eq_one_iff_integer (x : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 1 ↔
      x ∈ integerPoints := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Complex.re h
    simpa [Complex.exp_re] using (cos_two_pi_eq_one_iff_integer x).mp (by
      simpa [Complex.exp_re] using this)
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    simpa [Int.cast_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using
      Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I n

/-- Problem 9.8, in law form. -/
theorem prob_9_8 (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    characteristicFunction μ (2 * Real.pi) = 1 ↔ μ integerPoints = 1 := by
  rw [characteristicFunction, charFun_apply_real]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    have hexp : Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)) μ :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℂ)).mono (by fun_prop) (by
        filter_upwards with x
        simp [Complex.norm_exp])
    have hcosint :
        (∫ x : ℝ, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x) ∂μ) = ∫ _x : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by
      calc
        ∫ x : ℝ, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x) ∂μ =
            ∫ x : ℝ, (Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re ∂μ := by
              congr with x
              simp [Complex.exp_re, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
        _ = (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ).re :=
          integral_re hexp
        _ = ∫ _x : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂μ := by simpa using hre
    have hcos_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) μ :=
      (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono (by fun_prop) (by
        filter_upwards with x
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one (2 * Real.pi * x))
    have hae : (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 1 :=
      (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le hcos_int (integrable_const 1)
        (ae_of_all μ fun x => Real.cos_le_one _)).mp hcosint
    have hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ integerPoints := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
      exact (cos_two_pi_eq_one_iff_integer x).mp hx
    have := (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_integerPoints.nullMeasurableSet).mp hmem
    simpa using this
  · intro hμ
    have hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ integerPoints := by
      apply (ae_mem_iff_measure_eq measurableSet_integerPoints.nullMeasurableSet).2
      simpa using hμ
    calc
      ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ
          = ∫ _x : ℝ, (1 : ℂ) ∂μ := by
              apply integral_congr_ae
              filter_upwards [hmem] with x hx
              simpa [mul_assoc] using (exp_two_pi_I_eq_one_iff_integer x).2 hx
      _ = 1 := by simp

/-- Problem 9.8 in random-variable form. -/
theorem prob_9_8_randomVariable
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X P) :
    characteristicFunction (P.map X) (2 * Real.pi) = 1 ↔
      P {ω | X ω ∈ integerPoints} = 1 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (P.map X) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  rw [prob_9_8 (P.map X)]
  rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hX measurableSet_integerPoints]
  rfl
